title: Dependence on a coordinate set
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a set, let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The function $f$ depends only on the coordinates in $J$ if, whenever $x,y\in\Omega^n$ agree at every coordinate in $J$, one has $f(x)=f(y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
